title: Knight Driver Appreciation Week 2026 Recap
summary: Knight Transportation's Driver Appreciation Week 2026 featured $1,000 giveaways, friendly competitions, driver recognition, and celebrations nationwide. Read the recap and video!
body_markdown:
Every year, we come together to celebrate Driver Appreciation Week across all 22 Knight terminals nationwide.


Each September, we dedicate a week to honoring the men and women who keep America moving. It’s also a chance to step away from our daily routines and celebrate our drivers. From great food and giveaways to exciting events, raffles, and special recognition, the week is all about saying thank you for their hard work and sacrifices.


Driver Appreciation Week 2026 at[Knight Transportation](https://www.knighttrans.com/) was filled with big cash prizes, memorable moments, and plenty of fun.


As you enjoy this recap, be sure to watch our Driver Appreciation Week 2026 highlight video and relive the excitement.


## A Message to Our Drivers


Knight Transportation wouldn’t be where it is today without our drivers. You are the heart of this company, and we appreciate everything you do.


Whether you drive[Dry Van](https://www.knighttrans.com/dry-van/) ,[Refrigerated](https://www.knighttrans.com/refrigerated/) ,[Dedicated](https://www.knighttrans.com/dedicated/) ,[Flatbed](https://www.knighttrans.com/flatbed/) , or[Team](https://www.knighttrans.com/teams/) freight, each of you plays a vital role in our success.


Every mile you drive helps deliver for our customers and proudly represents Knight on the road. In fact, nearly every item we use each day spent time on a truck before reaching its destination. From food and clothing to furniture and household goods, truck drivers keep America moving.


Because of that, you have one of the most important jobs in our society and supply chain. Your career requires sacrifice, patience, dedication, and hard work every day.


While Driver Appreciation Week lasts only one week, our gratitude extends far beyond those seven days. We appreciate you all 365 days a year.


Thank you for your commitment to excellence, your dedication to safety, and the pride you bring to Knight every time you hit the road.


## Recap of our DAW Events


All 22 of our terminals hosted giveaways, raffles, and fun activities for our drivers. Each terminal also provided breakfast, lunch, and dinner to our drivers. It was a week filled with great rapport, recognition, and entertainment.


Here are some highlighted events from our[Mothership terminal, Phoenix](https://www.knighttrans.com/knight-life/office-shop/phoenix-trucking-terminal/) :


- Money Vault Machine
- Dodgeball Tournament
- RC Racing
- Wheel of Fortune and Fear
- 2nd Annual Truck Rodeo
- Half-Court Basketball Shot Content


## Money Vault Cash Grab


This year, drivers took part in our first-ever Money Vault Machine competition. Participants stepped inside the vault and had 30 seconds to grab as much cash as possible from the $1,000 available. That’s right, a full $1,000 in real cash was flying through the machine. This exciting event was proudly sponsored by[Rush Truck Centers](https://www.rushtruckcenters.com/) and[Peterbilt](https://www.peterbilt.com/) .


Throughout the challenge, drivers got creative with their strategies. They were encouraged to collect as much money as possible, as quickly as possible, by any means they could.


Some tucked cash into their shirts, while others stuffed their pockets or used their hats to hold more bills. In the end, our top winners walked away with more than $100 in cash.


## Dodgeball Tournament


The annual dodgeball tournament, hosted by our Arizona Refrigerated team, remains a Knight Driver Appreciation Week favorite. Arizona Dry Van and Arizona Refrigerated first battled for the chance to represent Operations in the championship, with Arizona Refrigerated advancing to the finals.


Drivers from multiple terminals also competed for the opportunity to represent Knight Drivers. Ultimately,[Operations](https://www.knighttrans.com/why-knight/) defended its title and took home the win for another year.


Every participating driver received a pair of work gloves. These gloves provide protection during daily tasks and are especially useful during pre-trip inspections.


## RC Racing


The 2nd Annual RC Racing Competition was another crowd favorite, hosted by our Arizona Dry Van Operations team. Drivers put their skills to the test on two custom-built courses, competing head-to-head until the final round.


For the championship race, the course became even more challenging. In the end,[Owner Operator](https://www.knightownerops.com/) John L. from the Katy Terminal claimed the title and took home the grand prize. While de dominated throughout the competition, runner-up Jeremy S. kept the final race close.


Prize winners included:


- **1st Place:** John L. ([Knight Katy](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/katy-tx/) ) received a pair of Dr. Dre Beats headphones and an RC car.
- **2nd Place:** Jeremy S. ([Knight Phoenix](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/phoenix-az/) ) took home a car refrigerator.
- **Tied for 3rd Place:** Bill M. and Travis W. ([Knight Phoenix](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/phoenix-az/) ) each won an electric grill.


Thank you to our Arizona Operations team for planning and hosting these exciting events. Your support helped make Driver Appreciation Week one to remember.


## Wheel of Fortune and Fear with the Joes


Midweek, drivers had the chance to spin the prize wheel for some extra fun. Each spin gave them a chance to win a prize or challenge one of our[Knight leaders](https://www.knighttrans.com/about-us/#knight-leadership) , while still walking away with a prize.


Meanwhile, **Knight President Joe Vitiritto** and **EVP of Sales & Account Management Joe Sherer** joined in on the excitement and proved to be great sports. Thanks to a lucky few spins, the two Joes found themselves dancing, singing, exercising, and even taking a sweet pie to the face to close out the event.


We appreciate both Joes for helping create a memorable experience for our drivers. Throughout the event, drivers won TVs, Yeti cups, gift cards, Knight Pro Shop items, and more.


Of course, none of it would have been the same without our host, Will P. from the Driver Training team. He kept the energy high, the crowd engaged, and the laughs coming all afternoon.


## 2nd Annual Truck Rodeo


This year, we proudly brought back our Truck Rodeo to the Phoenix Terminal, with support from[Vanguard Truck Centers](https://vanguardtrucks.com/) .


Knight drivers and owner-operators competed for a chance to win the $1,000 grand prize. In addition, the top rookie driver had an opportunity to earn a $200 cash award.


Once again, **Safety Project Manager** Danielle Pretzer and **Phoenix Shop Manager** Aaron Acres led the event. Drivers were required to complete four skills-based tasks and were scored on accuracy.


Meanwhile, Bobby C., **Vanguard Regional Parts Sales Manager** , announced competitors and interviewed drivers after their runs. Later, the Vanguard team presented the $1,000 check to the Truck Rodeo champion.


Congratulations to Our 2026 Truck Rodeo Winners!


- **1st Place Champion:** Thomas Campbell ([Knight Tulsa](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/tulsa-ok/) ) – $1,000 Cash
- **2nd Place:** Arturo Nunez ([Knight Phoenix](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/phoenix-az/) ) – $250 in Gift Cards
- **3rd Place** : Victor Paunescu ([Knight Memphis](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/memphis-tn/) ) – Yeti Cooler
- **Best Rookie:** David Zambrano ([Knight Phoenix](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/phoenix-az/) ) – $200 Cash


## Half-Court Basketball Shot Competition


For the fourth year in a row, the Half-Court Basketball Shot Competition returned as one of Driver Appreciation Week’s most anticipated events. A special thank you goes to Don Blake and the[Inland Kenworth team](https://www.inland-group.com/) for continuing to make this fan-favorite challenge possible.


This year, only one driver walked away with the $1,000 prize. **Jose Gonzalez** from our[Salt Lake City Refrigerated Terminal](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/salt-lake-city-ut/) stepped up at the Phoenix Terminal and made the shot count. With no help from the backboard, Jose drained the half-court shot and secured the win.


However, what made the victory even more meaningful was the story behind it. Jose has been a Knight driver since 2012 and is a proud father of three. Two of his children currently attend Ivy League universities on full-ride scholarships. His daughter is a junior at[Harvard University,](https://www.harvard.edu/) and his son is a freshman at[Columbia University](https://www.columbia.edu/) .


After sinking the winning shot, Jose shared that he plans to use the prize money to help his daughter. Whether it’s purchasing a new computer or an electric scooter for campus, the prize will help support her educational journey.


Stories like Jose’s are a reminder that every driver has a purpose beyond the road. Behind every mile is a family, a dream, and sacrifices made to create opportunities for loved ones.

Driver Appreciation Week would not have been possible without the support of our incredible sponsors. Their generosity helped us provide meals, raffle prizes, and unforgettable experiences for our drivers across the country.


Some of our amazing sponsors who deserve recognition:


- [Premier Truck Group](https://premiertruck.com/)
- [Rush Truck Centers](https://www.rushtruckcenters.com/)
- [RWC](https://rwcgroup.com/)
- [Fleet Pride](https://www.fleetpride.com/)

We are grateful to each and every sponsor who contributed to making Driver Appreciation Week 2026 a success.


To our drivers, thank you again. You are the backbone and heart of Knight and America. This week was about you, but our appreciation is year-round.


Watch our[2026 Driver Appreciation Recap Video](https://youtu.be/-Utec4OaYtg) and experience the highlights from this years events.
